issues.detail: The Greek 'τις καλει υμας των απιστων' means 'if someone calls you [the] unbelievers', but the Vietnamese 'có người không tin mời anh em' translates to 'if there is a person who does not believe, invite/call you'. It misses the fact that 'unbelievers' is the object (you) being called, not a description of the person doing the calling.
